dynamicVars.dynamicVar: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' ORDER BY table_name

dynamic-sheet.name: ${tableName}
dynamic-sheet.query:
SELECT 'CREATE TABLE ' || table_name || ' (' || E'
' || string_agg(' ' || column_name || ' ' || CASE -- numeric 타입 등의 precision/scale 처리 WHEN data_type = 'numeric' AND numeric_precision IS NOT NULL THEN data_type || '(' || numeric_precision || CASE WHEN numeric_scale IS NOT NULL THEN ',' || numeric_scale ELSE '' END || ')' -- character varying 등의 길이 처리 WHEN character_maximum_length IS NOT NULL THEN data_type || '(' || character_maximum_length || ')' ELSE data_type END || CASE WHEN column_default IS NOT NULL THEN ' DEFAULT ' || column_default ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN is_nullable = 'NO' THEN ' NOT NULL' ELSE '' END, ',' || E'
' ) || E'
' || ');' AS create_table_sql FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' -- 대상 스키마 AND table_name = '${tables_list.tableName}' -- 대상 테이블명 GROUP BY table_name;
